tool_input.command:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/setup_alpine.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Send commands to the QEMU VM via the log/console
# We need to interact with the running VM

# First, let's check if we can communicate with the VM
# The VM is running, now we need to set up SSH

# Create a script that will be injected into the VM
cat > /tmp/alpine_setup.txt << 'SETUP'
root

echo 'root:password123' | chpasswd
apk add --no-cache openssh
echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
echo 'PubkeyAuthentication no' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sshd -D &
SETUP

echo 'Setup script created at /tmp/alpine_setup.txt'
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/setup_alpine.sh
/tmp/setup_alpine.sh
